egis.title: BIM Manager - Infrastructure (Utilities & Roads)

The BIM Manager will provide technical support to the infrastructure modelling team, lead coordination meetings, perform clash detection, and develop Dynamo automation scripts to enhance project efficiency. The role also covers the development and implementation of BIM Execution Plans, information delivery plans, and Common Data Environment (CDE) governance, ensuring that project information is managed consistently from design through handover.
As part of the role, the successful candidate will be required to regularly review and improve BIM delivery workflows and stay up to date with industry innovations and best practices to maximise project delivery efficiency.
Key Responsibilities 
Digital delivery and standards 
Develop and maintain BIM Execution Plans (BEP), EIR responses, and MIDP/TIDP in line with ISO 19650 and project requirements.
Set up and manage the CDE in ACC, including folder structures, permissions, naming conventions, and approval workflows.
Define and monitor model quality standards, including LOD/LOIN, model checking, and audit routines.
Ensure compliance with client and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, RTA) for BIM deliverables and information exchange.
Leadership 
Lead and mentor the infrastructure modelling team, providing day-to-day technical guidance and support.
Develop and deliver training on BIM standards, tools, and workflows.
Develop, maintain, and roll out BIM standards, templates, and best practices across projects.
Act as the main BIM point of contact for clients, authorities, and project stakeholders.
Lead coordination meetings and model review sessions across disciplines.

Minimum of 10 years of professional experience, with proven expertise in delivering infrastructure projects using BIM in accordance with ISO 19650 standards.
Advanced knowledge of Civil 3D and Navisworks.
Strong expertise in ACC and understanding of its processes.
Proficient in Dynamo for Civil 3D, including developing scripts for automation and process improvements.
Proven ability to lead coordination meetings, manage interdisciplinary teams, and facilitate model review sessions.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey technical information and collaborate across teams.

Relevant Autodesk certifications (e.g., Civil 3D, Navisworks).
Background in large-scale infrastructure projects, including utilities and road design.

sixt.title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Pricing (m/f/d)
sixt.description:
Pricing is the engine of our business, and you’ll own it. In your role will take a business goal and drive it all the way to a validated outcome in production — shaping the solution with Product, designing it, shipping it, and proving it moved the metric it was meant to move. It is car-rental yield management — perishable inventory, real-time decisions, made millions of times — and one of the most consequential systems at SIXT. Join Team Orange in Pullach close to Munich and own it.

You own pricing problems end to end — from ambiguous business intent to a running production system you are accountable for: writing it, testing it, deploying it, and monitoring it live
You partner with Product as a peer, co-owning the outcome: translating business goals into technical strategy, challenging unclear framing, and proposing better solutions instead of waiting for a spec
You turn ambiguity into clarity — specifications with measurable acceptance criteria, the real edge cases named, and a concrete plan for validating the result after launch
You make quality structural by encoding standards as automated checks so whole classes of issues are blocked rather than caught in review, and root-cause problems so they don’t recur — because in pricing, mistakes are expensive
You use AI tooling as a genuine engineering lever — moving faster from spec to working C++, accelerating root cause analysis, generating test coverage — and help define where it actually earns its place in the pricing stack
You set technical direction for performance, reliability, and correctness across the pricing stack, and raise the bar for the engineers around you

Experience You are experienced in C++ or GoLang as your primary language in a latency- and correctness-critical pricing core where the details matter
Ownership You build scalable distributed systems, without anyone telling you how; 
Systems Thinking You reason honestly about trade-offs in reliability, performance, and correctness, design clean subsystem contracts, and debug across services to genuine root cause — you know where things break and why
Motivation You ask what problem we are solving before what should I build and measure your success by outcomes, not lines of code
Soft Skills You are proactive, even in a high-stakes domain where precision matters and the numbers you move are real
Team Spirit You collaborate with Product and engineering peers, challenge unclear framing confidently, and compound your judgment on architecture and outcomes

sixt.title: (Senior) Java Engineer – Workforce Intelligence (m/f/d)
Staff Data Scientist  – Offer Intelligence (m/f/d)
sixt.description:
We work at the intersection of pricing science, offer personalisation, advanced statistics, and scalable software. You'll build and bring into production state-of-the-art probabilistic models - like hierarchical Bayesian regression, SVI, or bandit algorithms - that power millions of pricing and offer decisions at SIXT every day. Beyond pricing, we're building the intelligence layer that decides which offer and which experience each customer sees, so your models shape both what we charge and what we show. From shaping the analytical question to deploying live models, you'll own the full lifecycle, supported by an innovation-friendly culture and great team. If you're excited by real-world impact, rigorous methods, and turning cutting-edge ideas into production - even if you don't tick every box - we'd love to hear from you!
YOUR ROLE AT SIXT 
 
•  You architect and prototype advanced regression models (linear, GLM, mixed-effects, Gaussian Process) with a principled Bayesian approach, guiding pricing strategy at scale
•  You design and productionise personalisation and recommendation systems - two-tower retrieval, embedding-based candidate generation, learning-to-rank, sequential/transformer models - with contextual bandits and off-policy evaluation to keep them learning from real interactions
•  You apply techniques like SVI, MCMC, and importance sampling to enable robust decision-making under uncertainty, even with sparse, high-volume, or streaming data
•  You build and maintain reproducible pipelines for feature engineering, label generation, and automated data validation using tools like Airflow or Dagster, ensuring high code quality and reliability
•  You deploy models via FastAPI, Docker, or Kubeflow, and establish real-time monitoring with Bayesian control charts and performance dashboards to catch drift and anomalies early
•  You design sophisticated A/B and multivariate tests, apply quasi-experimental and causal impact methods, and quantify the value of information to balance exploration and exploitation
•  You collaborate with product, revenue, and customer experience leaders to translate ambiguous ideas into testable hypotheses, while mentoring peers and elevating Bayesian practice through internal publications and workshops
 
YOUR SKILLS MATTER 
 
•  Expertise You bring deep statistical chops, with 5+ years of applying regression, hierarchical models, or state-space methods in production
•  Computing proficiency You have a well-stocked Bayesian toolbelt - fluent in PyMC, Stan, NumPyro, TFP, or similar - and are comfortable writing custom likelihoods and priors
•  Modeling You have proven experience scaling inference using SVI, black-box VI, or advanced MCMC techniques on large datasets
•  Personalisation (nice to have) You have experience with recommender and personalisation stacks - two-tower / embedding retrieval, learning-to-rank, sequential models, contextual bandits - plus counterfactual or off-policy evaluation to prove incremental value rather than optimise click-through
•  Engineering practices You write solid, production-grade Python code and are familiar with type hints, testing frameworks, and CI/CD workflows
•  Infrastructure You are hands-on with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, and have experience with containerization (Docker/K8s) and workflow orchestration
•  Stakeholder management You communicate uncertainty, lift, and risk in plain English for executives, while engaging deeply with scientists and engineers

sixt.title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d) - Revenue Management
sixt.description:
Revenue Management at SIXT runs on systems that gather, interpret, and act on huge amounts of commercial data from our Pullach near Munich headquarters. Pricing decisions are made automatically, at scale, with automation and agentic tooling doing more of the work every quarter. This role owns how those systems are built: the architecture, the hardest technical calls, and the engineering bar that keeps them correct when every decision is real money.
You'll work across our Revenue Management engineering teams as the senior hands-on technical voice: setting direction where it spans teams, going deep where the problem is hardest, and raising the bar for everyone around you. You partner closely with multiple Engineering Managers, their teams, and product owners: they own what we build and why, you own how, and whether it will hold.
We use AI heavily across engineering, and part of this platform is agentic. We're hiring someone who can design, build, and harden systems where some of the behavior is generated rather than written.
YOURS TO OWN 
You own the technical direction for our Revenue Management systems: architecture, service boundaries, data flows, and the long-term cost of today's choices. You write it down, invite the challenge, and make the call
You build the engineering pipeline: how agents code, test, and ship our work across teams, the eval loops that tell us it's working, and the standards other engineers build on
You stay close to the code where it counts: the problems nobody else can unblock: performance, correctness, migrations, incidents. You lead through the pipeline and its standards, not by sitting on the critical path
You design how we know these systems are right: testing, evaluation, and observability for pricing logic and agentic components whose behavior is easier to observe than to inspect. You set the guardrails: what runs autonomously, where a human stays in the loop, and how things fail safely
You own quality standards and make them enforceable: the Non Functional Requirements (latency, reliability, cost, auditability), architectural constraints that fail the build instead of waiting for a reviewer, and tech debt strategy as measurable constraints you can enforce in code, pipelines, and reviews
You grow the engineers around you through design reviews, pairing, and honest feedback. Part of engineering is remote, so decisions live in writing: design docs and ADRs that someone outside the room can act on. You spot what's newly possible, especially with LLMs and agents, prove it with a prototype, and turn it into something the teams can build on
YOUR SKILLS MATTER 
Technical Depth You bring many years of experience building and operating production backend systems, and you still write code you'd put your name on. You are strong in multiple languages and comfortable with cloud solutions
Distributed Systems You've designed systems that process high-volume data and make decisions in near real time: APIs, event streams, storage, consistency, failure modes. Tell us about the incident you learned the most from
Applied AI Assistants and agents are already part of your daily workflow. You've built or shipped LLM-based or agentic systems and know how to evaluate them, constrain them, and tell when they're wrong
Technical Leadership You've set technical direction across multiple teams and it held, know when to build it properly and when good enough is right, can explain the cost of both, and you're willing to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so. Tell us the instance, the disagreement, what happened after
Written Communication You can write a design doc that changes minds and still makes sense a year later. Bring a real example
Domain Knowledge You have experience in pricing, revenue management, or other commercial decisioning domains

Verknüpfung von theoretischer Informatik und praktischer Softwareentwicklung

Skills Du bringst Spaß am Programmieren und erste Programmiererfahrung (z. B. aus Schule oder eigenen Projekten), Neugier auf neue Tools wie Agentic Coding, die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen zu verstehen und zu erklären, präzises Arbeiten, Teamgeist sowie frische Ideen mit

sixt.title: (Staff) Software Engineer – Rental Platform (m/f/d)
sixt.description:
In this role you will shape the future of software that seamlessly connects physical branches worldwide with real-time technology. You will design and lead software architecture for over 2,000 branches in more than 110 countries. Your role combines deep technical insight with hands-on presence in the field, bridging software and hardware to enable the next generation of SIXT’s rental experience. Sounds exciting? Then apply now and join Team Orange in our headquarters in Pullach close to Munich.
YOURS TO OWN 
You set the architectural direction for the software that runs every SIXT branch. Counter, checkout, key handover, vehicle exchange and return, plus the devices and IT services connecting them. End-to-end across the branch surface
You design at the software ↔ hardware intersection. Counter PCs, customer tablets, POS terminals, scanners, keyboxes — you model how our software speaks to physical devices in real time, and you shape the integration patterns the whole organisation will adopt
You drive system-design choices across the branch domain — event-driven flows, API contracts, state ownership, device-to-cloud protocols, the boundaries between modern services and legacy interfaces. This is hands-on architecture, not architecture-by-slide-deck
You grow the engineering practice around you — across the multiple teams that touch the branch (Checkout, Counter, Rental Platform, Turnaround, Keybox, Tablet/POS) through clean design docs, sharp technical reviews, and hands-on engagement when a problem is gnarly enough to warrant it
You spend real time at the branches. The strongest architecture is shaped where the system actually runs — with agents, with devices, and with customers
YOUR SKILLS MATTER 
Expertise You have several years building production software systems at meaningful scale — customer-facing, multi-region — with a track record of taking systems from "they work" to "they are elegant and they scale"
System design depth You can sketch the architecture of a non-trivial system and defend every choice — from API design and data modeling, through event/stream patterns and state ownership, down to the trade-offs in how services talk to each other and to the outside world
Comfort at the software ↔ hardware boundary You have shipped software that talks to physical devices — POS hardware, retail or restaurant systems, embedded clients, real-time stateful client-server protocols (MQTT, WebSockets, gRPC streaming). You know "the device is misbehaving" is part of normal operation, and you design for it
Tech-stack range You are comfortable with Backend in Go / Java / Python, event streams (Kafka), databases (Postgres / Redis), and cloud (AWS / Kubernetes). Bonus for experience integrating with legacy systems you cannot rewrite — only design around
Influence and craft You have led architectural change across multiple teams through clarity, evidence and follow-through. You write design docs people actually want to read
 
WHAT WE OFFER 
Extra benefits Enjoy discounts on SIXT rent, share, ride and SIXT+, attractive vehicle leasing offers, and exclusive deals with partners for travel, tech, fashion and more
Mobility boost We support you with a monthly mobility allowance of €20 per month for even more freedom
Future security We contribute to your retirement plan and support you with capital-forming benefits to ensure you are well covered
Feel-good atmosphere Stay active with our modern SIXT gym, various leisure activities like the gaming area or the SIXT choir, and enjoy our high-quality employee restaurant
Flexibility Enjoy 30 days of vacation and a hybrid working model with flexible hours
Giving back Take one day each year to volunteer at a charitable organization dedicated to supporting children

About us: 
We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!
